title: Recovering a Forgotten Password
drDigitalIntro:
Forgetting a password is not a disaster. Every real site has a way back in, and it runs through your email.

- Click 'Forgot password?' on the sign-in page. The site emails you a link.
- Leave the site, open your Mail app, and find the message. It usually arrives within a minute.
- The link takes you back to the site with a page for choosing a new password.
- The link expires, often within the hour, so do it while you are sitting there.
- If a reset email turns up and you did not ask for it, do not click it. Somebody else is trying to get into your account.

playgroundTask.scenario: A password reset that spans the browser, the Mail app, and back to the browser
playgroundTask.goal: You reset a forgotten password and got back into your account

steps.say: Your password is not working. Click 'Forgot password?' on the sign-in page.
The link is in your email. Open the Mail app from the dock.
Open the message from First National Bank.
Click the reset button in the email — it hands you back to the browser.
Type a new password you have not used anywhere else.

drDigitalSuccess: You crossed three windows to do that — the site, your email, then back to the site. That back-and-forth is what a real password reset feels like, and now you have done one.
drDigitalHint: The reset link never appears on the website itself — it goes to your inbox. The Mail app is in the dock along the bottom.
